correctness.rationale: Exhaustive enumeration of all valid arc subsets using the proved five-arc cutoff; 714 cells in exact face cardinalities 18,108,264,252,72. Deterministic matching gives 341 disjoint pairs; full Hasse DAG tests are acyclic before and after four unique-gradient-path cancellations. Residual CW cells 0:1,3:19,4:12 and exact signed Morse differential zero. Hurewicz gives null four-cell attaching maps, proving wedge homotopy. The standalone checker in this package executes every finite step.

value.rationale: The balanced cubic biclique is a naturally symmetric first higher-degree test of taking both arc orientations, as opposed to one-way complete bipartite orientations. Exact integral mixed-dimensional homotopy refines Euler-characteristic and field-homology descriptions and isolates effects of directed length-two cycles.
